note: Standard list rates, USD per million tokens. Claude Sonnet 5 also had introductory pricing of $2.00 input / $10.00 output per MTok running through 2026-08-31. The standard rate is recorded here on purpose: ROUTING["coding"] is a durable production setting and must not be chosen on a discount that expires within the month. Recording the intro rate instead would not change the outcome anyway, because Sonnet 5 at xhigh emits roughly 5.3x the output tokens of Opus 4.8 at high, which swamps the lower per-token rate under both schedules. This file is a committed INPUT and is never generated from a model response.
